I'm Dr. Renee Tucker, an equine veterinarian with 30 years of experience healing horses, and I developed the Tucker Biokinetic Technique to help horse owners and caretakers better understand and care for their horses. 

TBT combines veterinary medicine with holistic practices to fix any horse issue at its root, not just the symptoms, and fix it forever. This energy technique can be learned by anyone at home and utilizes the horse's immune system, other internal healing mechanisms, and the energy linkage between the horse and the TBT practitioner. My hundreds of clients and their testimonials are proof this works.

Learn how to help your horse using Tucker BioKinetic Technique at www.TuckerBioKinetic.com
